title: Thompson — Motif-Index Top-Level Classes
license: system/idea (the 23-class lettered taxonomy); the full ~46k-motif index text is copyright and NOT reproduced — the fine-grained motif table comes from the CC-BY-SA `trilogy` dataset at fetch time
tier_note: The micro-tier taxonomy ROOTS: the 23 lettered chapters. Content atoms (individual motifs like D1361.4) hang off these; the leaf table is loaded later from `trilogy`. `code` is Thompson's chapter letter (note the index skips I, O, Y).

items.name: Mythological Motifs
items.description: Creators, gods, the establishment of the world; cosmogony and the origins of things.

items.name: Animals
items.description: Mythical and magical beasts, helpful and hostile animals, animal kingdoms.

items.name: Tabu
items.description: Prohibitions and the consequences of breaking them.

items.name: Magic
items.description: Transformations, magic objects, spells, and enchantment.

items.name: The Dead
items.description: Resuscitation, ghosts, revenants, and the soul.

items.name: Marvels
items.description: Otherworld journeys, marvelous beings and places, extraordinary occurrences.

items.name: Ogres
items.description: Ogres, giants, cannibals, witches, and other devouring monsters.

items.name: Tests
items.description: Recognition, tests of identity, cleverness, and prowess; quests.

items.name: The Wise and the Foolish
items.description: Wisdom, cleverness, and their opposite — folly and absurd actions.

items.name: Deceptions
items.description: Deceits, thefts, cheats, disguises, and illusions.

items.name: Reversal of Fortune
items.description: The lowly raised and the mighty brought low; unpredictable outcomes.

items.name: Ordaining the Future
items.description: Judgments, bargains, promises, oaths, curses, and prophecies.

items.name: Chance and Fate
items.description: Wagers, luck, accidents, and the workings of fortune and fate.

items.name: Society
items.description: Kings, courts, social classes, customs, trades, and institutions.

items.name: Rewards and Punishments
items.description: Deeds rewarded and punished, and the kinds of each.

items.name: Captives and Fugitives
items.description: Captivity, abduction, escape, pursuit, and rescue.

items.name: Unnatural Cruelty
items.description: Cruel relatives, murders, mutilations, and abandonment.

items.name: Sex
items.description: Love, marriage, courtship, chastity, and birth.

items.name: The Nature of Life
items.description: Reflective observations on the way of the world; the just and the unjust.

items.name: Religion
items.description: Religious services, beliefs, virtues, and the sacred.

items.name: Traits of Character
items.description: Favorable and unfavorable traits of personality.

items.name: Humor
items.description: Jokes, humor of discomfiture, and lies.

items.name: Miscellaneous Groups of Motifs
items.description: Formulas, symbolism, heroes, and motifs not otherwise classified.
